svg.title: Use Chrome’s Install page as app option (recreation)
svg.desc: Recreated Chrome desktop controls. More is at the right edge of the address bar. Cropped menu panels show Cast, save, and share and Install page as app. Their placement is representative, not an observed exact Chrome build.
